rationale: Both blocking findings are resolved by the fix-up diff and no new high-risk issue was introduced. CR-001: read and update now share one isValidFile validator (numeric version, non-array object connectors), update throws ConfigurationError for every shape read treats as corrupt, covered by unit tests per shape and CLI tests for enable/exclude/include against a version-less file. CR-002: Copilot Chat onUntrackedHook returns silently for preferences-corrupt, analytics-disabled and project-excluded ahead of the unchanged scope/identity tail, covered for all enforced and non-enforced events including corrupt scope, missing identity and a disconnected connector. Deferred items from the final round remain deferred (pre-existing patterns shared with the Claude/connector-scope stores).
